findings:
StatCard `sm:text-4xl` dropped — The value

class was changed from `text-3xl sm:text-4xl` to `text-3xl font-mono`, losing the responsive size step at ≥ 640 px. Any page using StatCard outside the hologram section will show slightly smaller values on tablet/desktop. Add `sm:text-4xl` back alongside `font-mono` if the responsive size is intentional elsewhere.
